title.en: Asking to Join a School Club

subtitle: 錯過社團報名，寫一封簡短有禮的信給指導老師
task: You want to join the photography club at your school, but you missed the sign-up day. Write a short email to Ms Lin, the teacher in charge of the club. Introduce yourself, explain why you missed the sign-up day and why you want to join, and ask if you can still sign up.
taskZh: 你想加入學校的攝影社，但錯過了報名日。寫一封簡短的 email 給負責社團的林老師：介紹自己、說明為什麼錯過報名以及為什麼想加入，並詢問現在還能不能報名。
focus: email 格式：稱呼、自我介紹、結尾署名
清楚說明寫信目的與請求

en: My name is Amy Chen, and I am a first-year student in Class 102. I am writing to ask if I can still join the photography club. I was sick on the sign-up day, so I missed it. I have loved taking photos since I was ten, and I want to learn how to use a real camera. Could you please tell me if there is still a place for me?
zh: 我叫陳艾咪，是 102 班的一年級學生。我寫信是想詢問我是否還能加入攝影社。社團報名那天我生病了，所以錯過了報名。我從 10 歲起就很喜歡拍照，也想學習怎麼使用真正的相機。可以請您告訴我，社團是否還有名額？
